title: Five A.M.

start.note: Phone call to the night desk at 04:15: 'Flowers first. They open early.'

objectives.text: Flower District, W 28th St at dawn
Catch the tyre-slashers in the palms
objectives.note: Dawn, among Moretti's potted palms (soft collisions) Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.text: Bring it to Mayhew, the Shamrock Rail

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

mobile: Walking at dawn, two blocks between stops, no timers. Moretti's sidewalk jungle of potted palms is a soft-collision crowd, so take it slowly. Both collection choices are untimed.
design: P3: the Flower District at 5 a.m. Moretti refuses and tells Teddy about her slashed tyres (seeds Villalba). The Baeks pay with their calculator out and ask for a receipt (P1 as comedy). If flag.teddy_returned_tax, Mayhew finds the count short by fifty (handled in dialogue). COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act23_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
